items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I met this guy called Ricardo Marrerro. And he started to form a group... eventually stayed in the band, and that band recorded one album for Fania Records

ctx.x: Did you continue to play gigs as you got in your teens and so forth?

Yeah. I finally made it to High School of Music and Art, again as a percussion major, and I met this guy called Ricardo Marrerro. And he started to form a group, and that was really the first time I played flute in a group. I remember my first flute solo was at a church. And I just came to look at the band and I had my flute with me and he kind of forced me to go up there and play a solo. And eventually stayed in the band, and that band recorded one album for Fania Records, so that was a long, long time ago. So…
